# image2pdf v1.1.0 — Security Texture, Live Preview & Dark Mode

The biggest update yet for **image2pdf**: watermark textures, a live preview landing, freehand pencil editing, a bilingual UI with dark mode, and full SEO/branding work.

## ✨ Added

- **Continuous security-texture watermark** — `CONFIDENTIAL·CONFIDENTIAL·…` with zero word/line gaps, rotated as a single block (0°, −30°, −45°), selectable color; like banknote security paper
- **Live document preview (hero)** — canvas rendering of the final pages that updates instantly on every change; two-column single-page landing, light minimalist theme
- **Freehand pencil tool** — continuous lines with custom color and 3–80 px thickness, smart undo, touch support
- **Bilingual UI (EN/ES)** — in-page switcher, `?lang=` param, `localStorage` persistence, browser auto-detection
- **Dark mode** — 🌙/☀️ toggle, persisted, follows system preference
- **SEO foundation** — canonical URL, Open Graph/Twitter cards, JSON-LD (`WebApplication` + `FAQPage`), `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`
- **Branding** — `image2pdf` logo as favicon, header logo and social image (optimized: 657 KB → 18 KB WebP)

## 🔧 Fixed

- Pencil strokes collapsed to single dots → now continuous
- Watermark vertical gaps eliminated (row pitch compensates for rotation)

**Full changelog:** [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/alkiory/imageToPdf/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
